item.description: The actress made a surprise appearance in the Puerto Rican artist's "La Casita," alongside Alix Earle, Cardi B, Karol G, Pedro Pascal, Ronald Acuña Jr. and Young Miko.

item.title: Oscar Nominees Luncheon: A Year After California Wildfires, Event Returns to Hilton, With Lots of A-Listers and Love for ‘Sinners’
item.description: Two hundred and thirty nominees — among them Steven Spielberg, Emma Stone, Leonardo DiCaprio, Kate Hudson and Timothée Chalamet — packed the Beverly Hilton's international ballroom on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: ‘The White Lotus’ Cast: See Who’s Checking in for Season 4
item.description: With the upcoming installment of Mike White’s HBO drama set to take place in Château de la Messardière in Saint-Tropez, France, the confirmed list of people appearing in the upcoming season has begun trickling in.

item.title: Margot Robbie Recalls Telling Co-Star “F*** You” After Gifting Her Book About Eating Less
item.description: "He essentially gave me a book to let me know that I should lose weight," the actress said.
